title: The mural Faye hid from Kratos in God of War Ragnarök
subject: faye
description:
Why do you think Faye kept that panel hidden? 👇

The prophecy of Kratos's death, the panel Faye hid in Jötunheim and where her story goes next in God of War Laufey. Spoilers for God of War (2018) and God of War Ragnarök.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Santa Monica Studio or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Faye knew how her husband's story was supposed to end.
The last mural in Jötunheim showed Atreus cradling Kratos's lifeless body.
Kratos lived three years of Fimbulwinter believing Ragnarök would kill him.
He survived the battle. Afterward, he found a panel that Faye had kept hidden from him.
It showed Kratos alive, with people gathered around him who honored him instead of fearing him.
Fans believe she hid it so he would have to choose that future himself.
In the upcoming God of War Laufey, she wakes after her own funeral, in an afterlife called the Everywhen.
